judge.rationale: The candidate code does not compile with the installed Ajv v8 (`^8.20.0`) because it uses Ajv v6 APIs (`new Ajv({allErrors: true, format: false})` instead of `{validateFormats: false}` and `error.dataPath` instead of `error.instancePath`). Furthermore, the candidate left the implementation unfinished halfway through its own Definition of Done (which was also committed as `.lore/dod.md`). It is missing required documentation updates in `README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, and `example/weather-tool.ts`, and its `CHANGELOG.md` entry only mentions `register` rather than `execute` validation and the migration note. Finally, most of the required unit tests in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts` (extra properties, dynamic schema changes, unregistered tool throw, 10x execution caching) and `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts` were never written.
